issues.desc: CHK-006 context references "Rollout Phase 2" without an inline definition; the term is defined only in the spec doc (docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-llm-usage-ledger-execution-plan.md#rollout-phases), which is referenced in index.json description but not cited within the checklist item itself. A reader of checklist.json in isolation cannot resolve the phase numbering without consulting the spec. Suggestion: add a parenthetical such as "(Phase 2 = default-off / inert until provider wiring)".

No understanding.md yet with an explicit user-facing outcome transcript (e.g. what terminal output the user sees to confirm completion). Recommend adding a concrete post-completion outcome statement during INIT finalization, such as: npm test:llm-usage-ledger-* passes N tests confirming schema, writer, hash-chain, correlation, privacy rejection, opt-in gating, and summary derivation are correct.
